audit_revision: MGC c.0 was replaced before the final run by local MGC v.0 because c.0 lacked the exact 13:29 settlement bar on more than half of observed sessions; the replacement criterion was timestamp coverage only.

closure.reason: The raw effect replicates on 6E and ZN, but no tested instrument is profitable after the frozen all-in cost assumptions.
closure.reopen_only_if: Observed all-in round-trip execution cost is sustainably below the frozen gross break-even cost for at least one raw survivor, followed by prospective revalidation without changing the signal.
closure.threshold_warning: These are zero-expectancy break-even ceilings, not target costs or evidence of deployability. A safety margin and prospective realized-fill evidence are required.
forbidden_on_reopen: increasing contract count to offset negative unit expectancy

phase_1_gate.description: Proceed beyond raw-effect falsification only if at least one instrument has beta > 0, HAC |t| >= 1.96, positive mean sign edge in the full and 2017-2026 samples, and more than half of eligible calendar years positive.

method.bar_timestamp_semantics: UTC bar-start timestamps converted with IANA time zones
method.signal_price: close of the one-minute bar [T-31,T-30), observable at T-30
method.roll_rule: exclude an event when instrument_id at the previous close differs from instrument_id at signal, entry, or exit; if instrument_id is unavailable, flag roll safety unavailable
method.zero_signal_rule: no position; retained for regression but excluded from sign hit-rate
